caption:
Mr Turtle has been glued to his desk for weeks of exam prep, and his shoulders feel like rocks.

Long stretches in one position can leave muscles stiff. Remedial massage can help you feel less tense and more comfortable, and it works well alongside regular movement breaks rather than replacing them.

Hybi's study break: stand up every 30–45 minutes, roll your shoulders back 10 times and do 5 chin tucks.

Frequent headaches, tingling in the arm, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 📚

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
